rationale: Tests classification threshold knowledge: ACC/AHA 2017 defines Stage 1 HTN at 130/80, distinct from JNC 7's 140/90
Distinguishes hypertensive urgency (no acute TOD) from emergency (acute TOD present) — a key clinical differentiation tested in this content block
Tests selection of appropriate baseline investigations — a core clinical evaluation skill covered in this diagnostic workup block
Tests the principle that cardiovascular risk stratification integrates multiple risk factors beyond BP alone — the key message of the risk integration content block
Tests drug-class selection with compelling indications — a critical prescribing decision covered in the pharmacological treatment block
Tests the management principle in hypertensive emergency: controlled BP reduction by ≤25% in first hour, NOT rapid normalisation — a critical safety rule
